notes: Prism 2.2.1: a polish pass on 2.2. The app icon is now Prism's own triangle mark, notes that are still transcribing show a loading skeleton instead of placeholder text, and the layout no longer jumps a few pixels when a scrollbar appears. Same private transcription: your audio is never stored — it passes straight through and comes back as text, and calls up to three hours transcribe in one go. Free. Requires internet for transcription and notes; recording still works offline.
